originalTitle: Trump-linked oil venture delays Greenland drilling plans after government warning
summary: Greenland Energy Co. and joint venture partner 80 Mile have delayed planned oil drilling in Greenland until winter 2027.
content:
A Texas-based company with links to President Donald Trump has delayed plans to drill for oil in Greenland, after the Arctic island's government issued a " strong warning " to its joint venture partner for bringing equipment ashore without permission.

Greenland Energy Co. , a Nasdaq-listed oil and gas exploration firm, said Wednesday that it was now working toward a targeted permit timeline for winter 2027, delaying its plans to try to unlock the hydrocarbon potential of the Jameson Land Basin on Greenland's east coast.

London-listed 80 Mile , the joint venture partner of Greenland Energy for the project, also confirmed the delay to drilling plans following talks with Greenlandic authorities.

"Operating in the Arctic requires patience, flexibility and a long-term perspective. We will use this time to refine our plans and deepen relationships with local communities, strategic partners and relevant authorities," Greenland Energy Co. CEO Robert Price said in a statement.

80 Mile holds the licenses and runs the permitting through its wholly owned subsidiary, White Flame Energy. The exploration licenses were granted before Greenland stopped issuing new licenses in 2021, citing the worsening climate crisis .

The project delay comes two weeks after Greenland's government issued a sharp rebuke to White Flame Energy for failing to get permission from local authorities to bring drilling equipment to the island's east coast.

Greenland Energy Co. and 80 Mile both confirmed to CNBC that the companies received a formal warning from Greenland's government.

Greenland's government issues a warning

The notice from Greenland's government to 80 Mile concerned the landing of drilling equipment near the strategically important Nerlerit Inaat Airport, a transport hub regarded as the gateway to northeast Greenland.

Ahead of the landing of equipment, Greenland Energy and 80 Mile said they had permission from and entered into a contract to lease storage space within an existing Greenland Airports storage area near the port but were unaware that this arrangement required a separate permit from the mineral resources authority.

Greenland's government said late last month that White Flame Energy did not have the necessary approvals before initiating this operation.

Greenland Energy and 80 Mile said in a joint statement that they "take the warning very seriously and note it in full." They added that they intend to "work closely" with Greenlandic authorities going forward.

80 Mile holds three licenses for exploration and possible exploitation of oil in the Jameson Land Basin. Greenland Energy is funding the costs associated with managing two exploration wells.

Shares of Greenland Energy closed more than 44% lower on Wednesday, while 80 Mile shares were down over 20%.

Greenland Energy and the Trump administration

The push to explore the oil potential of the Jameson Land Basin comes as Trump has renewed his push to acquire Greenland .

Greenland Energy has links to several people and businesses associated with the Trump administration.

Board member Carol Craig founded a defense tech company involved in a Pentagon contracting program supporting Trump's Golden Dome missile defense initiative.

The company also has a documentary deal with Envoy Media, founded by "Dr. Phil" McGraw, who spoke at a Trump rally in 2024 and serves on the president's Religious Liberty Commission.

Larry Swets, an entrepreneur and the chairman of Greenland Energy, has been reported to be close to the Trump administration. According to the Guardian , Price was asked during a meeting on the Jameson Land Basin in June whether Swets had links to Trump and replied, "Not that I know of."

Greenland Energy, which was formed through a special purpose acquisition company merger in March, says its primary mission is to unlock the frontier oil potential of the Jameson Land Basin, a roughly 2-million-acre onshore licensed area.

It describes the area as one of, if not the last, highly prospective yet completely undrilled basins in the world, with clear genetic links to the North Sea and a scale comparable with many of the world's major producing regions.

Lewis Lawrence, senior research analyst of Europe upstream at Wood Mackenzie, said there is clearly potential associated with the area, noting the geology appears to be genetically similar to the mid-Norwegian shelf, "which obviously is one of the hotbeds of oil and gas activity."

But past attempts to drill in promising spots in Greenland have failed, he added.

"There has been exploration in Greenland in the past [and] that's all been unsuccessful. So, 21 wells, most of them offshore, and they have all been unsuccessful wells. There's been hundreds of millions of dollars wasted, particularly on offshore drilling, which is significantly more expensive," Lawrence told CNBC in a phone interview.

"So, companies have had a look. They've come, they've drilled, they've not found anything and they've left."

Lawrence also said there would be logistical challenges on the basin, which he called one of the most remote drilling sites in the world.
chineseTitle: 政府警告后，与特朗普有关的石油企业推迟了格陵兰钻探计划
chineseSummary: 格陵兰能源公司和合资伙伴 80 Mile 将格陵兰岛的石油钻探计划推迟到 2027 年冬季。
chineseContent:
一家与唐纳德·特朗普总统有联系的德克萨斯州公司推迟了在格陵兰岛钻探石油的计划，此前格陵兰岛政府就其未经许可将设备带上岸的合资伙伴发出了“强烈警告”。

纳斯达克上市的石油和天然气勘探公司格陵兰能源公司周三表示，目前正在努力制定 2027 年冬季的目标许可时间表，推迟其试图释放格陵兰岛东海岸詹姆森陆地盆地碳氢化合物潜力的计划。

在伦敦上市的 80 Mile 是格陵兰能源公司该项目的合资伙伴，在与格陵兰当局会谈后也证实了钻探计划的推迟。

格陵兰能源公司首席执行官罗伯特·普莱斯在一份声明中表示：“在北极开展业务需要耐心、灵活性和长远眼光。我们将利用这段时间完善我们的计划，加深与当地社区、战略合作伙伴和相关当局的关系。”

80 Mile 持有许可证并通过其全资子公司 White Flame Energy 负责管理。这些勘探许可证是在格陵兰岛以气候危机恶化为由于 2021 年停止发放新许可证之前颁发的。

该项目推迟两周前，格陵兰岛政府因未获得地方当局许可将钻探设备带到该岛东海岸而对 White Flame Energy 发出严厉谴责。

格陵兰能源公司和 80 Mile 均向 CNBC 证实，这两家公司收到了格陵兰政府的正式警告。

格陵兰岛政府发出警告

格陵兰岛政府向 80 Mile 发出的通知涉及钻井设备降落在具有重要战略意义的纳勒里特伊纳特机场附近，该机场是格陵兰岛东北部门户的交通枢纽。

在设备着陆之前，格陵兰能源公司和 80 Mile 表示，他们已获得港口附近现有格陵兰机场存储区的许可并签订了租赁存储空间的合同，但他们不知道这种安排需要获得矿产资源管理局的单独许可。

格陵兰岛政府上个月末表示，白焰能源公司在启动这项业务之前没有获得必要的批准。

格陵兰能源公司和80 Mile在一份联合声明中表示，他们“非常认真地对待这一警告，并予以充分记录”。他们补充说，他们打算今后与格陵兰当局“密切合作”。

80 Mile 拥有三份在 Jameson Land Basin 勘探和可能开采石油的许可证。格陵兰能源公司正在资助管理两口勘探井的相关费用。

周三，格陵兰能源公司股价收跌逾 44%，80 Mile 股价下跌逾 20%。

格陵兰能源公司和特朗普政府

随着特朗普再次推动收购格陵兰岛，推动探索詹姆森陆地盆地的石油潜力。

格陵兰能源公司与特朗普政府的多个个人和企业有联系。

董事会成员卡罗尔·克雷格创立了一家国防科技公司，参与支持特朗普金顶导弹防御计划的五角大楼合同计划。

该公司还与 Envoy Media 达成了纪录片协议，Envoy Media 的创始人是“菲尔博士”麦格劳 (Dr. Phil McGraw)，他曾在 2024 年的特朗普集会上发表讲话，并在总统的宗教自由委员会任职。

据报道，企业家兼格陵兰能源公司董事长拉里·斯威茨与特朗普政府关系密切。据《卫报》报道，普莱斯在 6 月份詹姆森陆地盆地的一次会议上被问及斯威茨是否与特朗普有联系，他回答说：“据我所知没有。”

格陵兰能源公司是在三月份通过一家特殊目的收购公司合并而成立的，该公司表示，其主要任务是释放詹姆森陆地盆地的前沿石油潜力，该盆地是一个占地约 200 万英亩的陆上许可区域。

它将该地区描述为世界上最具前景但完全未钻探的盆地之一，即使不是最后一个，与北海有着明显的遗传联系，其规模与世界上许多主要产区相当。

Wood Mackenzie 欧洲上游高级研究分析师刘易斯·劳伦斯 (Lewis Lawrence) 表示，该地区显然具有潜力，并指出该地区的地质似乎与挪威中部陆架相似，“这显然是石油和天然气活动的温床之一”。

但他补充说，过去在格陵兰岛有希望的地点进行钻探的尝试都失败了。

劳伦斯在接受 CNBC 电话采访时表示：“格陵兰岛过去曾进行过勘探，但都没有成功。所以，有 21 口井，其中大部分在海上，但都没有成功。浪费了数亿美元，特别是在海上钻探上，成本要高得多。”

“所以，公司已经看过了。他们来了，他们钻了，他们没有发现任何东西，他们就离开了。”

劳伦斯还表示，该盆地将面临后勤挑战，他称该盆地是世界上最偏远的钻探地点之一。
